text:
maria: Heads-up — spotted a weird billing delta vs committed GPU hours for eu-west-1.
aj: what kind of delta? % or $?
maria: ~18% over committed hours for last billing week, but committed capacity shows full coverage in the reservations dashboard.
leo: any SKU mismatches? e.g., committed A100 vs actual used g5?
maria: exactly — commitments are listed under 'a100-40gb' family in the contract, but billing export shows heavy usage on 'a100-80gb' and 'a100-40g-v2' SKUs. Likely mismatch in provider SKU normalization after their migration.
aj: oof. Could be provider renamed SKUs during maintenance. billing-bot: Automated alert — disparity detected: committed_hours=12,345 ; billed_reserved_hours=10,456 ; billed_on_demand_hours=2,012 ; potential_loss_estimate=$14,300.
sana: do we route certain model types to different instance types? maybe model auto-scaler picked a different variant.
maria: yes, routing policy 'high-memory' maps some Llama-2 configs to the 80GB variant when sequence length > 8k. That coincides with the timing.
devin: can we confirm by joining the billing export with our request routing logs? I can drop a query.
leo: share the query so infra + finance can run it.
devin: here's a quick BigQuery skeleton — adapt dataset/table names:

`````
SELECT
  b.invoice_month,
  b.sku_description,
  SUM(b.usage_hours) AS billed_hours,
  SUM(COALESCE(r.committed_hours,0)) AS contracted_hours
FROM `company.billing_export.gcp_line_items` b
LEFT JOIN `company.commitments.committed_gpu_hours` r
  ON b.project_id = r.project_id
  AND REGEXP_CONTAINS(b.sku_description, r.gpu_family)
WHERE b.region = 'europe-west1'
  AND b.invoice_month = '2026-02'
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY billed_hours DESC;
`````

devin: run that and then pivot by instance_type used in our routing logs (logs table has model_variant -> instance_type mapping).
aj: action: maria + devin to run query and attach CSV to this thread. sana to check routing policy change history around Feb 10.
maria: will run now. quick note: we've seen provider-side SKU aliasing before; last time they provided a mapping CSV in their portal.
sana: tagging finance: @leo can you loop in billing contact if we need a credit?
leo: will escalate if we confirm mismatch. also propose short-term fix: add normalization layer mapping deprecated SKUs to committed families in our capacity router.
maria: agree — can ship a small opt-in mapping in router by end of day. devin can you estimate risk of rollout?
devin: low-risk — fallback to family-level routing if mapping missing. estimate 2-3 hrs dev + 1 hr ops to roll out and monitor.
aj: cool. please add a small smoke test: trigger long-sequence request and ensure it routes to 40GB variant when preferred.
billing-bot: Reminder — attach billing export CSV with query run time, and tag this thread with invoice_ref if you want finance lookup.
maria: uploading initial CSV now (attached: billing_delta_eu-west1_feb.csv)
leo: received. I'll do a quick delta calc and ping provider contact if needed.
sana: +1 on mapping and smoke tests.
aj: thanks team. status updates here — once we have confirmation we'll decide on refund vs mapping fix.
maria: update: early signal shows 90% of overage maps to 80GB SKU bump. filing provider support ticket with mapping evidence.
leo: good. I'll prep note for finance with estimated exposure and action plan.
maria: I'll follow up with logs + CSV by EOD. :thumbsup:
